acceptance: RUBRIC 1: M1 and M2 measurements recorded (CI vs local labelled) and each change applied or skipped with the reason
RUBRIC 2: for any applied change, CI time of the subprocess CLI tests vs their post-longtest-05 module sums (C5)
context: DONE 2026-10-22 (both changes skipped by their gates; no product change). M1 region probe: measured on CI (temporary measurement PR #3283, closed unmerged; run 39773109551, ubuntu-latest, 3 samples): discover_client_region 0.009-0.013 s per process (AWS 0.0035-0.0044, GCP 0.0012-0.0015, Azure 0.0046-0.006 s; Azure IMDS answers on the runners). Locally 0.81 s on macOS where 169.254.169.254 does not answer. Result already cached per process (benchbox/platforms/base/client_region.py _get_cached_imds). Far below the 0.3 s gate; skipping it for local platforms would also change recorded client_region. Skip. M2 chunking: benchmark_loader.py:63 sets parallel to the logical CPU count (10 on the review's Mac, 4 on CI); TPCHDataGenerator defaults to 1; deliberate one-chunk-per-CPU design. Row sets identical for 1 vs 10 chunks at SF 0.01 and 0.1 (SHA-256 per table, local). Local SF 0.01: 1 chunk 1.9-2.3 s, 4 chunks 1.7 s, 10 chunks 2.3 s; no gain from one chunk. Skip. Leftovers: branch fix/cli-probe-datagen-chunks and worktree ../BenchBox.wt-cli-probe-datagen-chunks (measurement only).
description:
PROBLEM (from the CLI review, both local and unverified on CI): every CLI subprocess probes cloud metadata endpoints for the client region (about 0.8 s locally), and TPC-H data generation at SF 0.01 runs 10 chunks where each chunk costs about as much CPU as generating the whole dataset in one process. Both are paid by every CLI end-to-end test and by users.

CHANGES (each only if its gate passes):
1. Region probe: skip it when the run does not need a cloud region (local platforms), or cache it per process; keep behaviour for cloud platforms.
2. Chunking: trace where the chunk count for tiny scales comes from; if more than one chunk below a size threshold is unintended, generate in one chunk below that threshold.

DECISION GATES:
M1 Measure first, on the CI runner (a throwaway step or a CI log of a CLI test with timing around the probe): if the probe costs under 0.3 s per process on CI, record and skip change 1.
M2 For change 2, generated data must be identical in rows (sorted row set per table) before and after, at SF 0.01 and 0.1; manifests may change only in chunk layout; the TPC-H answer/qualification tests pass. If the chunk count is deliberate (documented or tested), record and skip.
M3 Product change: CHANGELOG entry; no change to the documented CLI surface.
